request: Restrict the opaque clipped SVG leaf batch path to clip boundaries that can affect the leaf

implementation.behavior: Test path coverage against every retained rounded clip in local coordinates. Fully contained and completely excluded leaves keep the ordinary path. Crossing, touching and near-edge coverage keeps the audited batch path.
implementation.antialias: A one-device-pixel fringe is necessary: skipping a coincident fractional edge changed 7 pixels in the retained failing native check.
implementation.transforms: Inverse clip transforms account for translations, scaling and reflection; rounded-corner containment is checked geometrically.

hacker_news.conclusion: The gate alone does not remove the HN instruction regression. No production performance improvement or target attainment claimed.

retained_failures.geometric_containment: The initial geometric-only edge predicate failed at a coincident clip edge; replaced with device coverage containment.
retained_failures.pixels: The first six pixel captures passed but their backend override was stripped by the guard interpreter. No candidate-code validation credited. Corrected launches set the loader environment after the guard and verify it.
retained_failures.hn_preflight: The first wrapper tried to resolve the candidate dylib in isolation; the dependency helper could not resolve its own @rpath install name. Corrected preflight resolves it with executable rpaths. No browser trials in that preflight.

broad_cadence: Full 13-suite native raster batch completed. No measured optimization savings credited; no package/translation suite reruns required for this native-only gate.
